**Blockers:** Jason explicitly paused all implementation/delivery. The listed acceptance boundary remains unproved beyond linked historical receipts.

**Next step on explicit resume:** After explicit Jason resume, refresh exact source/live and predecessor evidence, then satisfy: A clean environment reports pinned tool versions and runs the declared compile fixture reproducibly.

**Acceptance retained:**
- [ ] A clean environment reports pinned tool versions and runs the declared compile fixture reproducibly.
- [ ] No tool install grants Secret, exec, device or cross-namespace access; absence of credentials fails safely.
- [ ] Owning fleet delivery and generated repo references agree; no redundant image is introduced solely for convenience.
